declaredBeforeScoring.rule: main session, 2026-11-09, under the owner's answer of the same day ("Continue with what you recommend, you have access to the gpu", choosing: keep round 4 live and build a round whose split never touches a building, scored on a fresh sample): score round 4 (as locked in detector-lock-r4.json, the live detector) and round 6 once each on the new evaluation sample Z1-Z6. Round 6 replaces round 4 only if it beats round 4 on Z1-Z6 on both F1 and recall with precision at least 0.95 (the detector, as rounds 4b and 5 were decided; a roof crown no detector splits counts against both alike). Otherwise the trees stay at round 4's detector. If the chosen round also reaches precision and recall of at least 0.9 the gate passes outright; otherwise it is published under an owner exception citing the owner's standing rule of 2026-11-08 ("The best round go!") and his answer of 2026-11-09, pinned to benchmark-r6.
declaredBeforeScoring.strata: recall by stratum (isolated, group, edge, closed), by type and by height (3-8, 8-15, 15+ m) is reported with the totals; the garden windows (Z5, Z6) are also reported on their own
declaredBeforeScoring.secondary: the decided candidates (after the holds, the bank rule and the hold review) are scored on Z1-Z6 as a secondary number, which decides nothing; earlier rounds' locks are scored too and decide nothing
